:::{#thm-held-out-unbiased}
#### Held-out mean squared error is unbiased

If a held-out set is drawn from the same population as $(X_0, Y_0)$
and independently of the training set $\mathcal{T}$,
then the [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of the held-out predictions
is a conditionally [unbiased](estimation.qmd#def-unbiased) estimator
of the [generalization error](#def-generalization-error):

$$
\E{\frac{1}{m} \sum_{j=1}^m \prederr_{0,j}^2 \mid \mathcal{T}} = \generr_{\mathcal{T}}.
$$

:::

::: proof
This is @sol-held-out-unbiased.
:::
